topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: The package arrived, wrapped in a simplicity that belied the weight of its contents. It was addressed to someone I wasn’t, someone who had once lingered here and left only echoes. Opening it, my fingers traced the edges of a life not quite my own—photos, letters, perhaps a book with corners turned down. Each item whispered of a presence no longer felt, a warmth now absent. I set everything aside, carefully, as if handling fragments of a memory I never had the chance to make. The room seemed a little colder, a little emptier, with this reminder of what had been and would never return. I wondered where they were, if they missed this place as much as it missed them.
